description: Tracks the player's current location, travel state, and environmental conditions. This is the foundational context — it should reflect where the player is at all times.

fields.current_location: string — name of the player's current location (e.g. 'The Crossroads Inn', 'Darkwood Forest path', 'Village of Millhaven')
fields.destination: string or null — where the player is heading, if actively traveling; null when not in transit or upon arrival
fields.scene: string or null — brief description of the immediate surroundings (1-2 sentences)
fields.terrain: string or null — terrain type (e.g. 'forest', 'mountain pass', 'coastal road', 'dungeon corridor')
fields.weather: string or null — current weather conditions
fields.time_of_day: string or null — approximate time (e.g. 'early morning', 'midday', 'dusk', 'late night')
fields.nearby_npcs: array of strings — names or descriptions of NPCs visible or known to be nearby
fields.points_of_interest: array of strings — notable features, landmarks, or objects in the current area
fields.exits: array of strings — available directions or routes the player can take from this location

notes: When current_location changes, ALL other fields (terrain, exits, weather, nearby_npcs, points_of_interest) must be updated to match the new location — never carry forward stale values from the previous location.
When destination is reached, set destination to null.
Exits should always have at least one entry (e.g. 'the way you came') unless the location is explicitly sealed.
If an encounter interrupts travel, update current_location to where the encounter occurs, not the intended destination.
